messages:
maya: quick heads-up — starting rolling deploy rev 2026.03.20-rc2 -> 10% eu-west. please watch embed-service and autocomplete SLOs

...deploy-bot: deploy started: rev=2026.03.20-rc2 target=10% region=eu-west. healthchecks=on. link: https://deploys.redwood.com/3322001234

...deploy-bot: alert: embed-service 5xx_rate (1m)=1.9% (threshold=0.5%) — generating noise signal :warning:

trent: saw that — could be upstream timeout bursts. suggest pause at 10% until we triage

sre-lucy: can we avoid immediate rollback? looks like a noisy spike from one host. propose temp silence for the alert and broaden aggregation to 5m to avoid flip-flop

ops-oncall-jordan: logs from eu-west-proxy-3 show repeated `upstream read timeout`  — snippet:
```
2026-03-20T13:10:42Z proxy-3 embed-service GET /v1/embed 504 upstream read timeout id=abc123
2026-03-20T13:10:43Z proxy-3 embed-service GET /v1/embed 504 upstream read timeout id=abc124
```

maya: thanks. let's do a two-step: 1) pause traffic ramp at 10% (hold) 2) apply a 10m alert silence on embed-service 5xx alerts for eu-west while we investigate 3) if spike persists after 10m revert that region to rev=2026.02.10-stable

...deploy-bot: action: traffic_ramp_hold region=eu-west target=10% — acknowledged

...deploy-bot: action: silence_alerts service=embed-service metric=5xx region=eu-west duration=10m — acknowledged

trent: +1. if we see >0.7% after silence window, we should trigger rollback. I'll watch p95 too

maya: sounds good. create a short incident record and pin logs. @ops-oncall-jordan can you open inc/ with the logs and timeline? :memo:

ops-oncall-jordan: opened INC-2026-045 in tracker, attached logs and deploy link

...deploy-bot: follow-up: if rollback needed, run `deploy rollback --region eu-west --to rev=2026.02.10-stable` or request via this channel. I'll wait for confirmation.

sre-lucy: small note for post-analysis — consider adding a rule to ignore single-host spikes in the 1m window; makes our deploy-time alarms less noisy

maya: agreed. for now we hold. updating release notes and notifying product. :phone:

...deploy-bot: last status: hold in place. monitoring enabled. will post updates every 2m.
